I couldn't write these notes. The research tool was blocked before any page loaded. My first request was for the main sources: Enduring Word, Precept Austin, Augustine's exposition on newadvent.org, Bible Hub, Gill on StudyLight and Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* on CCEL. The system answered that I had no tool calls left for this turn, so nothing was retrieved.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and never fill gaps from memory. With no pages read, any notes I wrote would break those rules, so I haven't written any.

**To continue:** ask again in a new message and I'll start the research from scratch. I'll read these pages first:
- **Traditional reading:**
  - enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-55/
  - preceptaustin.org's Psalm 55 commentary
  - the Bible Hub verse pages for Ellicott, Pulpit, Gill and others
  - Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*
- **Catholic and Orthodox:** Augustine on newadvent.org. His Psalm numbering differs, so Psalm 55 appears there as Psalm 54.
- **Modern scholarship:** NET Bible notes on netbible.org.
- **Specific verses:**
  - the curse in vv. 15 and 23, where traditions may differ on how to read cursing psalms
  - vv. 12–14 and 20–21, the betraying friend, which some writers apply to Judas
  - v. 22, "Cast your burden," which some modern popular teaching uses
